spec.description: Five adjacent equal-width histogram bars, rising to a central peak and then falling; unnumbered arrowed axes labelled x and y.
spec.mathematics: Qualitative bar-height proportions reproduce the source. No numerical frequencies or class boundaries are asserted.

answer.worked: C. The data are approximately symmetric and concentrated near the centre, matching the narrow central box and longer whiskers.

answer.worked: B. The tail extends to the right, so the distribution is positively skewed, matching the long right whisker.

answer.worked: A. The tail extends to the left, so the distribution is negatively skewed, matching the long left whisker.

spec.description: Eight adjacent equal-width bars: equal low outer bars, four equal intermediate bars and two equal tallest central bars; unnumbered arrowed axes labelled x and y.
spec.mathematics: Symmetric relative heights 3, 7, 7, 9, 9, 7, 7, 3 are drawing proportions, not stated frequencies.
